title: Spire® 100 LED Beacon
subtitle: Compact LED beacon, 12/24V, amber or clear lens, permanent or magnetic mount.
description: The Federal Signal Spire® 100 LED Beacon delivers compact, brilliant 360° warning visibility for utility, municipal, and service fleets. Operating on 12/24 Vdc, it's available with amber or clear lens options and permanent or magnetic mounting for fast, flexible installation on work trucks and heavy equipment.
summary_bullets: Compact LED beacon with NightSpire® technology
Available in tall and short dome profiles

benefits: Compact footprint suits utility and service vehicles with limited roof space
Magnetic mount option allows fast beacon relocation between vehicles
